Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to draw and always carried her favorite pencil with her. One day, she met a boy named Max.

Max said, "I have a plan. Let's draw a picture of a fair together!"

Lily loved the idea and they started to draw. They drew a big ferris wheel, a carousel, and lots of people having fun. But suddenly, Lily accidentally broke her pencil.

"I can't finish the picture," she said sadly.

"Don't worry," said Max. "I have an extra pencil."

So they continued to draw, but when they finished, a gust of wind blew the picture away.

Lily and Max were very sad that their picture was gone. But they promised each other that they would plan another fair and draw it again.
